outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: Chips & semiconductors, led by AMD, Micron, and Broadcom
strongest.reason: AMD's Q2 beat topped a heavily-priced-in swing, Micron guided to a $50 billion revenue quarter, and Broadcom's AI-semiconductor guidance called for over 200% year-over-year growth, together reversing last week's AI-spending-sustainability selloff amid a 15th straight monthly record for global semiconductor sales

strongest.area: Enterprise software & cybersecurity, led by Palantir, ServiceNow, and Palo Alto Networks
strongest.reason: Palantir extended its blowout-earnings surge, ServiceNow continued higher on raised guidance, and Palo Alto Networks' upgrade and 60% next-gen-security ARR growth reinforced a broader rotation into AI-capable security and software platforms

weakest.area: Amazon, despite broader mega-cap cloud strength
weakest.reason: shares fell in pre-market trading after a fresh SEC filing showed a roughly $4 billion planned share sale, overshadowing the otherwise-strong AWS-acceleration narrative
NetApp gave back some recent AI-infrastructure-driven strength, while bitcoin and ethereum held up on price but face a fresh overhang after developers flagged dozens of critical protocol bugs

outlook.nextStep: The chip-sector bounce, led by AMD's earnings beat and Broadcom's AI-capex guidance, looks like the more durable story worth a closer look as the rest of earnings season plays out. Bezos' planned Amazon share sale and the newly disclosed bitcoin protocol bugs are more headline-driven and are probably better watched than acted on until more details emerge.

signals.title: Fed holds steady as new chair resets communication style
signals.body: The Fed kept rates unchanged at its late-July meeting in a 9-3 vote, with three officials dissenting in favor of a hike. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is bringing a less-signaling approach to policy communication, adding a layer of uncertainty even as the broader market pushes to fresh highs.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how markets adjust to a less predictable Fed communication style

signals.title: Chip-sector bounce builds on AMD's earnings beat and Broadcom's AI guidance
signals.body: AMD's Q2 report topped an already heavily-priced-in swing, Broadcom guided AI-semiconductor revenue up over 200% year-over-year, and Micron pointed to a $50 billion revenue quarter, together driving a broad rebound from last week's AI-spending-sustainability selloff. Global semiconductor sales just posted a 15th consecutive monthly record.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether this rebound has legs beyond the earnings-driven pop

signals.title: Bezos share-sale filing weighs on Amazon despite cloud strength
signals.body: A fresh SEC filing showed founder Jeff Bezos plans to sell up to 15 million Amazon shares, worth roughly $4 billion, sending the stock lower in pre-market trading even as the broader AWS-acceleration and cloud-earnings narrative remains intact.
signals.focus: better watched than acted on until the filing's market impact settles out

signals.title: Humanoid-robotics enthusiasm spreads across Tesla and Chinese listings
signals.body: Tesla shares extended their gain on continued Optimus humanoid-robot momentum, while a broader humanoid-robotics rally lifted Hong Kong and mainland China listings including UBTECH.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how much of this is narrative versus near-term production progress

signals.title: Palantir cools slightly after its blowout-earnings pop
signals.body: Palantir eased in pre-market trading as some investors took profits following its outsized post-earnings rally, while the broader enterprise-software group, including ServiceNow and Salesforce, continued to grind higher.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether the pullback is just profit-taking or a shift in sentiment

signals.title: Bitcoin steadies near $64K despite fresh protocol-bug disclosure
signals.body: Bitcoin and ethereum both firmed alongside the broader risk-asset rally, even as developers flagged dozens of critical bugs in Bitcoin's codebase and markets separately watch a large pending SpaceX share unlock that could add supply-side pressure to risk assets more broadly.
signals.focus: lower conviction right now until the bug disclosure's practical impact is better understood

signals.title: Cybersecurity names extend their run on sector-wide rotation
signals.body: CrowdStrike and Zscaler both pushed higher again, and Palo Alto Networks' upgrade and 60% next-gen-security ARR growth added to signs that institutional capital is rotating into AI-capable security platforms as enterprises consolidate onto fewer vendors.
signals.focus: worth a closer look given the string of positive fundamental catalysts across the group
